rule: After AIP potential is depleted the submarine must return to port to replenish fuel and oxygen tanks.

execution.authority: scenario_assumption: explicit port/depot, distance, work time and paired charge-equivalent fuel/oxygen inventory; none is a printed logistics rate
execution.eligibility: Friendly physical port complex and operational child depot; live nonstowed surfaced stationary submarine, known AIP stock, AIP and charging off, no AIP casualty
execution.reservation: Deduplicate identical intents; reject conflicts, sort actor IDs before atomically reserving both finite supplies; reservation is not replenished AIP
execution.completion: Credit once after continuous qualified work. Abort/cancel refunds the original reservation to the same depot ledger. Provider damage blocks further use; repair consequences are not invented.
execution.restart: No automatic AIP restart, battery charging or battery credit
